effect.name: Liquid Glass V2 High Quality (Background)
effect.description: (It'll burn out your GPU) Shader simulates the iOS 26/MacOS Tahoe window effect.
effect.author: Foxioo

parameter.name: /* Foxioo Liquid Glass V2 High Quality (Background) Shader | 2026.08.20 */
parameter.description: (It'll burn out your GPU) Shader simulates the iOS 26/MacOS Tahoe window effect.

parameter.name: Mixing
parameter.description: This variable is responsible for the visibility of the effect.

parameter.name: Multiplication
parameter.description: This value determines the multiplication factor for the colors to be applied; if set to 0, the color will be white; the closer the value is to 1, the more the pixel will be multiplied by the base color.

parameter.name: Radius
parameter.description: This value determines the size of the blur; higher values result in a larger blurred area, while a value of 0 means no blur.

parameter.name: Size
parameter.description: This variable specifies the size of the bavel in pixels.

parameter.name: Liquid
parameter.description: This value indicates the degree of distortion; negative values indicate concave distortion, while positive values indicate convex distortion.

parameter.name: ( Compatibility )
parameter.description: Here you will find options that have changed, but you can still achieve the previous effect.

parameter.name: Is Fusion Version Older Than 296?
parameter.description: (Only applies to Android and iOS!) This variable determines whether to use the newer background formatting. In Clickteam Fusion 2.5 for build 295.10 and earlier, the background texture was flipped along the Y axis, but this was changed in build 296.1. Check this option if you are using an older build!
